text:
Asha Patel: Postmortem posted for the metering/invoice drift incident (2026-03-02). Root cause: delayed aggregator run + a retry branch that double-counted tokens. I added remediation items in the doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-metering-2026

Liam Chen: Ack. Who's on reconciliation? need per-customer deltas to prepare credits.

Maya Ortiz: I'm on it. Initial pass shows most customers unaffected, but 4 accounts have notable positive deltas (~5-12%). Will post CSV by EOD.

Maya Ortiz: SQL snippet I used for the slice (also in the doc):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens_reported - tokens_expected) AS token_delta
FROM billing.raw_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-02'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY token_delta DESC;
```

Tom (acct): For impacted accounts propose provisional credits = token_delta * unit_price, then issue corrected invoices after reconciliation. Need invoice ids + amounts by EOD to prepare memos.

Asha Patel: Owners/timeline:
- Maya: full reconciliation + upload CSV with checksum today (owner: @Maya Ortiz).
- Liam: safety dedupe rehydrate in staging and PR for guard rails by tomorrow AM (owner: @Liam Chen).
- Tom: draft credit memos and corrected invoices, hold until CSV final (owner: @Tom (acct)).
- Eng (oncall): add monitor for retry-duplication-rate >0.1%/hr, ETA 1w (owner: @Liam Chen / eng-oncall).

Liam Chen: One operational note: duplication spikes near midnight UTC during batch window transitions. We should add a short freeze window for migrations. Ticket added in the postmortem.

Tom (acct): Rounding policy question: cents or dollars?

Asha Patel: Round to cents and include token math + CSV link in the invoice memo for transparency.

Maya Ortiz: CSV uploaded to the postmortem with columns: customer_id, invoice_id, token_delta, unit_price, credit_amount. Example rows for the 4: CUST-821, INV-9941, 12400, $0.0005, $6.20; CUST-104, INV-9942, 53200, $26.60.

billing-bot: Audit log: postmortem "billing-metering-2026" linked by Asha Patel at 1755012360.

Liam Chen: Adding recurring 2-week checks to monitor for regressions over next 6 weeks.

Tom (acct): Scheduling customer outreach next Tue after final reconciliation.

Maya Ortiz: My tasks done; CSV + checksum posted. Leaving thread open for Tom's confirmation when credits are issued.

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone. Please update this thread with any status changes so we have a single source for the remediation timeline. Tagging @finance for visibility :eyes:
